instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark monochrome aesthetic. Do not introduce any colors (no blue, no purple). Use only pure black, white, and shades of gray.
For the marketing site, use massive typography (up to text-6xl) with Outfit font, tight tracking (-0.05em), and bold weight. Keep body text thin and minimal.
Primary CTAs must be white pill-shaped buttons with black text. Secondary CTAs are ghost buttons or outlined pills.
The hero section should have the provided B&W portrait as a background image with a subtle dark gradient/overlay (max 50% opacity) to ensure text readability.
In the dashboard, rely on 1px subtle gray borders (#222222) and pure black (#000000) or very dark gray (#0A0A0A) backgrounds. Avoid gradients and soft shadows. Use sharp, flat surfaces.
Charts and data tables must use grayscale series (white to dark gray). No rainbow colors in charts.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive and key informational elements.
